title: Erasmus and the Reformers
dek: Of how a Catholic scholar's rushed Greek New Testament became the working text of the men who broke with Rome, and why he refused to follow them.

panels.label: Monks Told It
panels.text: Erasmus laid the egg and Luther hatched it. The humanist's mockery of the Church made the Reformation.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Erasmus supplied the Reformers' text, their Greek and their method. They drew conclusions he rejected, and he stayed in the Roman Church.

caption: Historical document
